component.name: Scratchpad
component.summary: Quick notes and scratchpad applet for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: Scratchpad is a panel applet for the COSMIC desktop that stores quick notes, commands, and snippets as plain Markdown files.

It supports live search and instant note creation, keyboard navigation, clipboard copy and paste, asynchronous atomic saves with external edit reload and conflict protection, soft-delete trash with undo, and configurable word wrap and font size.
